# Released round-three suite fixtures

These exact bytes were generated by the SHA256SUMS-verified ESS 0.38.0 Linux release
binary from `crates/specify/ess-compiler/tests/fixtures/absent-input.yaml`:

```console
ess verify conform synthesize --path crates/specify/ess-compiler/tests/fixtures/absent-input.yaml --out suite26.json
ess verify conform synthesize --path crates/specify/ess-compiler/tests/fixtures/absent-input.yaml --suite-format 5 --out suite27.json
```

Both contain three scenarios and zero synthesis refusals. The direct-return port
must regenerate identical bytes and preserve their absent-input vocabulary.
Direct returns use the new suite versions 28 and 29.
